properties.Name: Black River
properties.SpecialFeatures: Any ship that transits to Black River automatically transits to North Sea, regardless of remaining movement. In any season other than summer, the region’s Danger increases to 100%.

properties.Name: Forbidden Waters
properties.SpecialFeatures: Sailing through this region is punishable by death. Crews will refuse to sail through here unless led directly by a Hero. Any Hero caught traversing the region will immediately receive a Black Mark, and his faction will receive 2 Threat.

properties.Name: Eye of the Needle
properties.SpecialFeatures: Danger is doubled when transiting through this region instead of into or out of it.

properties.Name: Iron Lanes
properties.SpecialFeatures: A ship that remains “stationary” in the Iron Lanes during Summer converts each 25 Food in its hold to either 2 Steel, 5 Iron, or 250 Prints. The Iron Colonies only need 500 Food per year. If more than that is delivered, ships doing business with them make Iron Lane Competition rolls. Every ship rolls 1d100. The ships with the highest rolls receive the normal return for up to 250 Food. Food capacity is counted from the highest roll down. If the highest-rolling ship is carrying 250 Food, no other ships will receive the normal return. If it is carrying 300 Food, it will only receive the normal return on the first 250. The ships that do not win the competition for normal returns still lose all their Food cargo. They then evenly divide the remaining possible returns (20 Steel, 50 Iron, or 2500 Prints) based on their share of the Food sold.
